motion_rule: the camera swings round him without stopping while the belt carries him down the hall, cages sweeping across the frame every beat, his face to the lens; his head half the frame; new shot size each beat, one action per beat, the hero always driving it; the tall frame filled, no bars
character: a small slow loris with enormous round eyes and heavy rings under them, muzzle always clear of his paws
second_characters: ONE frantic shrew auditor working the lens, big in frame, throwing coin bags at him
props: ONE paper tally roll trailing from his paw, growing longer every beat
prop_continuity: the roll only grows to 8.50, then tears off and balls in his paws; the coins pouring past never land in it
environment: a coin counting hall at noon, daylight through the glass roof, sorting cages and coin towers packed a paw away both sides of the belt, no far wall
light_events: hard noon daylight bars his face every beat, cold rim one side, warm kick the other

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: dry chesty male voice, matter-of-fact, biting off each word, 4.4 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: gla-ZA, KRUG-ly-ye, u-div-LE-ni-ya, ne-do-SY-pa, STOL-ko, schi-TAT, NA-do
audio.pacing: 0.40-3.50, 4.20-5.55 and 6.20-7.85 each one breath; after 7.85 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: his jaw drops wide and his lips shape every syllable, brows and jaw alive, muzzle clear of paws and props, never a voice over
audio.sfx: belt rumble, coins pouring into cages, the roll ratcheting, the ball slapping the lens

timeline.a: he rides the belt into frame head first, the roll trailing from his paw, coins stacked at his shoulder
he swings round on the moving belt and puts his round eyes into the lens
he shoves a coin tower over past his shoulder, clear of his muzzle, as the belt runs him by
he rolls onto his side along the belt and rakes a stack of coins down with him
he drives the growing roll out at arm's length past the lens as the belt carries him
he takes a coin bag on his chest from the shrew at the lens, still riding
he heaves the bag off and it bursts, coins hammering the cages sweeping past
he rubs one paw at his eye from the side, the other flat on the belt, muzzle open to the lens
he ducks a second bag the shrew hurls and it bursts on the cages behind
he swings the roll out and it unspools away down the belt line behind him
he rakes a shelf of coins onto the belt with one arm as he passes it
he thrusts his face into the lens over the pouring coins, eyes stretched wide
he shrugs the whipping roll off his shoulder as the shrew hauls a cage past the lens
he tears the roll off and balls it to his chest, one lone coin left on the belt under it
he hurls the paper ball into the lens and rides on hugging that one coin, eyes wide

must_appear: one paper tally roll that grows every beat; his big eyes with heavy rings; at 8.50 he tears it off and one lone coin is left on the belt; at 9.20 he hurls the ball into the lens
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, night, dark scene, a parked camera, a background that never moves, a stopped hero, a hero seen from behind, a held pose, a closed muzzle while speaking, a paw over his mouth, a prop against his mouth, slow motion, a camera pulling back, a foreign accent, a word not in the lines, cyrillic letters, readable text, extra limbs
